profileHeader.headline: Recent Communications graduate seeking an entry-level marketing or content role to apply writing, research, and customer empathy skills.

dhpView.personalStory: After graduating from UTS with a Bachelor of Communications 18 months ago, Jordan is now actively seeking an entry-level marketing or content role. While gaining valuable customer-facing experience in hospitality, Jordan is eager to leverage academic learning and develop a career in content creation and marketing. Jordan feels a bit invisible in the current job market and is looking for a way to showcase skills and connect with opportunities.

insightCards.body: Seeking an entry-level content or marketing role to demonstrate writing, customer empathy, and project thinking.
